prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style (hand-painted, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, warm golden key light, cool teal shadows, muted saturation, epic and luminous, never grim). Use the attached image(s) only as reference as described; the first attachment is always the style reference for palette, rendering and light. Game-asset concept sheet, landscape 16:9, plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, soft contact shadow only, every piece isolated with clear space and a small neat label underneath. WEAPONS sheet 2, ranged and arcane: bows (short bow, longbow), thrown weapons (javelins, throwing axes, bolas), quivers, and arcane foci for the five arcane skills: WIND (feathered fan or staff), STONE (rune-carved maul-staff), TIDE (shell-and-crystal chalice), BLOOM (living-wood staff with leaves), OATHCRAFT (chain-bound tome and seal). Each weapon in COPPER, IRON, SKYSTEEL and RELIC tiers where it makes sense. Include a simple 1.8 m human silhouette for scale.
